purpose: Make God Mode changes release-aware by requiring security, AI policy, quality evidence, rollback, and CI readiness before completion claims.

gates.rule: No secrets, credentials, tokens, weakened access controls, or unsafe operational instructions.
gates.failureMode: A feature is not release-ready if it introduces secret exposure, unclear permissions, or destructive behavior.

gates.rule: Agent behavior must declare scope, autonomy boundary, safety boundary, tool boundary, and validation duty.
gates.failureMode: A feature is not release-ready if AI or agent behavior is not observable, controllable, and source-controlled.

gates.rule: Every module improvement must have acceptance criteria, evidence links, and a checker.
gates.failureMode: A feature is not release-ready if claims are not backed by contract, doc, and checker evidence.

gates.rule: Dashboard, Goals, Repos, Docs, Agents, Security, AI Policy, Rollback, Validation, and Handoff must each have explicit improvement evidence and visible remaining gaps.
gates.failureMode: God Mode is not release-ready if topic-by-topic growth evidence is missing, stale, or disconnected from the Command Center surface.

gates.rule: Every meaningful change must identify a reversible rollback path.
gates.failureMode: A feature is not release-ready if it cannot be safely backed out as a bounded slice.

gates.rule: Release claims require quality governance to include the relevant God Mode gates.
gates.failureMode: A feature is not release-ready if CI cannot enforce the new governance gates.

completionRule: Do not mark God Mode work complete until all required gates have evidence, feature growth is current, relevant validation commands have been run successfully, and commit/push/CI or explicit handoff evidence exists.
